A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GeoCAD, with matching core methods, experiments, and appendices. All 18 pages of v1 and 26 pages of v2 are readable, including figures and tables, supporting a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 and the appendices report original DeepCAD evaluations, human assessments, captioning accuracy, ablations, and sampling sensitivity results.

after.justification: The original experimental results are retained, alongside an additional qualitative sketch-editing example in Appendix H.

M1.justification: New Appendix H adds a sketch-editing adaptation: estimate loop centers and a symmetry axis, generate one replacement loop with GeoCAD, then reflect it to replace the second loop. The core captioning strategy, model, losses, and two-stage training remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Appendix H and Figure A1 add a qualitative scenario involving coordinated replacement of two symmetric loops, extending the previous individual-loop examples. DeepCAD remains the sole experimental dataset; no broader benchmark coverage is added.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains OpenAI-o3 with five-shot prompting, FlexCAD, and FlexCAD with five-shot prompting. The captioning-model comparison in Appendix A and model variants in Table 3 also retain the same participants.

E3.justification: The data split, training budgets, sampling parameters, metrics, 1,000-model generation evaluation, and 500-model/five-worker human evaluation remain unchanged. The new sketch-editing example does not specify a separate evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Appendix H adds one worked qualitative case illustrating symmetry-preserving editing across two loops. Existing captioning, pretraining, augmentation, model-scale, and sampling analyses remain unchanged, as do the failure cases moved from Appendix H to I.

E5.justification: Checklist item 7 newly states that fixed random seeds are used and performance is consistent across runs. The existing three-run averaging remains unchanged; no seed values, additional run counts, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests are supplied.

E6.justification: New Figure A1 illustrates replacing two circular openings with symmetric rectangular openings. All numerical results in Tables 1–4 and Appendix A remain unchanged, and the earlier qualitative outputs are retained despite appendix renumbering.

T1.justification: Neither version introduces theoretical results or proofs, and the existing geometric definitions and metric descriptions are unchanged. The new symmetry-handling workflow is an operational procedure, without a formal derivation or theoretical guarantee.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about local geometry control, approximately 221k captioned parts, two-stage fine-tuning, and improved generation quality, validity, and consistency. The expanded title explicitly mentions the already-used LLMs.

C2.justification: Appendix H newly explains how loop editing can support sketch-level editing through explicit symmetry handling despite missing inter-loop annotations. The existing discussion of structural conflicts and limitations of text-only instructions is retained in Appendix I.

D1.justification: The checklist newly reports supplemental code/data with reproduction instructions, a documented release plan, and worker compensation above minimum wage. Actual resource availability is not established by the PDFs. Appendix H also specifies string matching for coordinate extraction; existing training and hardware details are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds a citation to Straj: Self-training for Bridging the Cross-Geography Gap in Trajectory Prediction, numbered 60 in v2. The CAD research positioning remains unchanged; FlexCAD's shift from reference 60 to 61 is only renumbering.

P1.justification: The title is expanded, corresponding-author information and acknowledgments are added, and a NeurIPS checklist is inserted before the appendix. The new Appendix H shifts later subsection labels, while the main scientific narrative remains essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds the sketch-editing diagram as Figure A1. Existing appendix figures become A2–A4 and move with the reflowed material. Main figures and all four tables retain their visual content and structure; other layout changes accommodate the checklist and added text.

improvement.justification: Appendix H and Figure A1 provide useful procedural guidance and a concrete example for extending loop editing to symmetric sketches, modestly improving practical applicability. The gain is limited to one qualitative example. The checklist adds reporting statements, but its fixed-seed assertion does not establish statistical significance, and its resource-release claims remain unverified.
